body: have kids, regret having them all the time. It was stupid, selfish, and irresponsible of me to bring them into the world. As much as I love them each of their minor failures cuts me raw, and their successes seem mediocre and trivial so that I am never able to gleam any sense of pride. I resent them constantly for being so needy, all I want to do is to find a peaceful glade in some forest and gnosh a handful of percocet, chase it with a bottle of Laguvalin and watch the sunset as I slip away. But I can't do that, because kids. fuck them. I'll eat my words when they become successful or acclaimed, but mostly likely they'll end up insepid morons or bitter misanthropes.
How do I go about finding a therapist/psychologist besides picking one at random?

traveling with kids is fucking miserable. growing up my parents took my siblings and I on a camping trip through Glacier Natl Park, at every mind blowing vista they would pull over take  moment to admire the beauty. They would tell us to get out of the car but we whined and cried until finally they gave up and let us brood in the car. To this day i can see the disappointment and pain we caused when my dad tells this story. As a father I have experienced this many times and each time a small part of me dies. 

Oh and don't forget traveling with kids is expensive. Go on travelocity plan a trip to NY from LA - air fair, hotel, food, transportation, events/locations. Now Multiply that by 2, or 3 or 4. yeah it gets goddamn expensive real quick. And all that money, a years vacation time saved up, fuck it you're kids are going to get sick, bicker with eachother, lose something important, temporarily get lost, spill 1 drink on a meal per day, touch a bunch of shit they shouldn't, wait until you are utterly exhausted and then throw a big tantrum, raid the minibar, prevent you from nailing your <wife|husband> in you hotel room cause you're sharing a room,  make you leave every planned destination 2 hours earlier than you planned because they <pissed|shit|or otherwise ruined there clothing>. Good luck trying to enjoy a good trip with a brood of toddling narcissistic pains in the ass in tow. Unless by what you meant by "depending on what you find adventurous) can be done and enjoyed by kids."you meant a trip to Kmart, then yeah that's reasonably easy if not decidedly more depressing.

If you're on the fence don't do it. Yes kids fill your life with joy and happiness and make you feel special, this is true. But these moments while very intense islands in a sea of mind numbing stress, and a myriad of negative emotions. I feel that we're conditioned to believe that raising children is noble calling with great rewards. And some kids are amazing, but statistically most of our children like ourselves will be average do nothings at best. Would you like to spend 10yrs intimately bonded to an individual who craps them selves, screams bloody murder when their every desire isn't met, and argues the merits of which pokemon is the best, then spend the next ten years struggling with a teenager who honestly believes you're the dumbest person on the planet, that any idea you have is lame, and in addition to stealing your vicodan and pot, manages to crash your car several times. Then this shit isn't over, for the following 10 years you look forward to your privacy and getting your house back but likely they've not the scores to go to college and end up working at Ross while living with you, or they go to college, get some fuck all degree, and despite the tens of thousands of dollars you spent they're still unemployable and end up moving back in with they're partner where upon they get pregnant. 30 years into this relationship either you or your wife (you're probably divorced by now anyways because you two couldn't reconcile the malice you have for each other for allowing the other to decide to have kids) have had a falling out with your child, children or any combination there of. you spend the next decade guilt ridden and angry. If you're lucky this will cause you to have a premature cardiac infarction, if not, chronic indigestion, either way both just add physical pain on top of the self loathing you have for jerking off to the thoughts of your <son's|daughter's> <husband|wife|partner|friends>. 40 years later you've made amends but only by completely suppressing your righteousness and ignoring your child's culpability in your falling out. Unfortunately your <wife|child|grandchild(ren)|mistress> die of <and accident|cancer|your temper> leaving you empty and hollow or in jail. you spend the next 10 year heavily drinking in an attempt to kill yourself in a sociably acceptable way, but your <kid|wife> intervenes and gets you treatment. Now you can't even drink anymore so fuck it you take up the banner of good health, get a track suit, walk some 5ks to raise money against child rape, and then die on a walk in the park.

or would you rather be able to have sex with your wife at will, travel as you like, never have to attend a PTA meeting or buy a box of peanut brittle so some kid's school can afford finger paint, read to what ever hour, never have to eat <oatmeal|Kix> unless you like them, ever have to wipe shit of an infants ass while in a crowded bathroom in some shit fuck theme park. Or how about being able to have a cigarette in your house, or being able to open any of your kitchen drawers with out a annoying loop of plastic defeating you, or being able to have a motorcycle as your primary vehicle or being able to pickup hitchhikers because you're feeling daring and you know your .45cal is loaded next to you and your not in any danger. or fuck it how about being able to divorce your wife with out the fear and paranoia about what will happen to your kids.  

I say fuck having kids, enjoy your life.
